A tasty, fast option is **One‑Pan Lemon Garlic Chicken & Veggies**:  
Season chicken thighs with salt, pepper, paprika, and minced garlic. Sear in a hot skillet 4 min/side, remove. Add sliced bell peppers, zucchini, and cherry tomatoes; sauté 3 min. Return chicken, drizzle with lemon juice and olive oil, cover and simmer 8‑10 min until cooked through. Serve over quick‑cook couscous or rice. Ready in ~25 min with minimal cleanup.
